text: From time to time, it is necessary to remove BIA board of management directors who are no longer able to serve and add new directors to fill vacant positions, as set out in Chapter 19 of the Toronto Municipal Code. The purpose of this motion is to appoint three directors and remove three directors from Mimico Village BIA board of management. The removal of three (3) directors and appointment of three (3) directors to the Mimico Village BIA board of management will not affect the number of directors or quorum.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominee to the Mimico Village Business Improvement Area (BIA) board of management at the pleasure of the Etobicoke York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Farrell, Kelly Meffe, Lisa Monte, Ernesto 2.
